title: Changing Leaders Among Liars — The Crown of Mount Phyle
description: HotStuff (Yin, Malkhi, Reiter, Gueta and Abraham): four bandits on the crown, the job passing at every entry, and why one more stage lets a new holder take over as cheaply as an old one.
question: When some machines may lie, replacing a leader has been slow and costly. Can a new leader take over as cheaply as any ordinary step, and at the pace of the messages rather than of a timer?
how: We find out by exploring how four bandits holding a hilltop took turns keeping their loot scroll, each gathering the others' seals into one bundle instead of every man writing to every other.

papers.authors: Maofan Yin, Dahlia Malkhi, Michael K. Reiter, Guy Golan Gueta and Ittai Abraham
papers.title: HotStuff: BFT Consensus with Linearity and Responsiveness
